address: 54 Frith Street, Soho, London, W1D 4SL, United Kingdom
bio: While Chef-Owner Angelo Sato's Japanese heritage provides the basis for this modern, upbeat izakaya, his creative streak ensures the theatrical tasting menu takes on a style all its own. Clever flavour and temperature combinations feature throughout, as do the kitchen's immense precision and technical skill. The shokupan bread serving is a real event, packed with originality and showcasing a range of delicious accompaniments. Pumping music contributes to a great atmosphere, whilst sake 'journeys' are encouraged to add to the experience....
